description: Windows 11 desktop dock, status bar, modules and customizable themes.

script: if ($process.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw "Gloof Velopack setup failed with exit code $($process.ExitCode)." }
foreach ($requiredFile in $requiredFiles) { if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $requiredFile -PathType Leaf)) { throw "Gloof installation is incomplete; required file is missing: $requiredFile" } }
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $updateExe -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'Gloof Update.exe was not found; refusing to remove the Scoop files while the Velopack installation may remain registered.' }
if ($process.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw "Gloof Velopack uninstaller failed with exit code $($process.ExitCode)." }

notes: Non-portable Velopack installation: the setup is directed into the Scoop version directory; this is not a standalone portable build.
Gloof targets Windows 11 and includes its own Velopack updater, which may update the application independently of Scoop.
